answer: Fraud-proof bounties make fake identities costly: every new agent escrows 18 POA for 24 epochs, and any peer who proves two accounts share a controller wins 60% of that escrow. Like timber floating from island to island, linked accounts leave traceable ties, and a marble-hard ledger record settles each claim. Each extra clone adds 18 POA plus 25% more than the last, so costs compound.
